description: Defines the PostgreSQL_MCP class implementing INode, which provides methods to interact with a PostgreSQL MCP server, including listing actions and initializing tools based on credentials.

classes.name: PostgreSQL_MCP
classes.description: A class representing a PostgreSQL MCP node with methods to load actions, initialize, and retrieve tools.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains the listActions method to asynchronously list available actions from the MCP server.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node by filtering tools based on specified MCP actions.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Fetches tools from the MCP server using provided credentials and configuration.
